source.title: Video Log 2024-10-24: Experimental Projects, Bendy Bones, and Sequence Review
source.description: It's been over a month since the last report, so there's a lot in this one. 00:00 Intro 00:23 Static Website Migration Review 01:13 Content Security Policy issues (fixed already?) 03:24 Rationale for Monthly Experimental Projects 05:08 [The Impossible Voyage](https://tv.filmfreedom.net/w/26URzTwcZgU8wyVMjeruqa) "Techno+FX Edition" Soundtrack 07:31 [Raven Rap](https://tv.filmfreedom.net/w/bMCjxAzLR6mgsivjYfhhWS) 13:58 Possibilities for November / 2D Animation Packages ([Synfig](https://www.synfig.org/), [OpenToonz](https://opentoonz.github.io/e/)). 17:12 [Foley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foley_(filmmaking)), [Digital Foley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lon_Bender#Digital_Foley_System_%28DFS%29), and [Hydrogen](http://hydrogen-music.org/) 19:51 Lunatics Project Progress 20:00 PLSS Control Panel Animation & Camera Movement 21:00 Context in Suiting Up sequence 21:39 Velcro Strap and Bendy Bone Rig 22:49 Dissatisfaction with Suiting Up sequence (Problems to solve) 24:50 Train Sequence problems to solve 26:08 Press Conference lipsync animation missing 26:47 LA & SF Interior Soyuz animation 27:46 Episode run-length 29:04 Conclusions 31:20 Red berries on the vine in Fall See also my [Production Log Post on Experimental Projects](https://lunaticsproject.org/2024/10/24/two-experimental-productions-for-october/).
